identity.description: An attacker uses Windows command-line utilities to split a file into chunks by size, mimicking Unix behavior. Cortex detects this as a rare Windows process pattern. The attack includes downloading a payload, splitting it, and staging for execution.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare Windows Process Divided Files by Size
biocs.description: Detection of Windows process splitting files by size, an uncommon behavior in Windows environments.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'split'
| filter action_file_path contains 'size'

xql_queries.name: Detect Rare File Splitting Behavior
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'split'
| filter action_file_path contains 'size'
| comp count() as cnt by action_file_path
| comp count() as cnt by
